Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in data synthesis and normalization logic. After WebSurfer provided clear evidence that "Man's Search for Happiness" was released in 1964 (at the World's Fair), the Planner incorrectly decided to "normalize" this film's release date to 2019 (based on a later YouTube upload) to match the release window of "Tell It to the Bees." This arbitrary decision ignored the actual historical release date (1964), which is significantly earlier than "Tell It to the Bees" (2018/2019). By forcing a 2019 date for the 1964 film, the Planner created a false equivalence that led to the incorrect conclusion that "Tell It to the Bees" (or its 2018 premiere) was the earlier film, contradicting the factual reality that the 1964 film was released decades earlier.
